claims.text: Amlodipine was stopped on or before 2026-08-18 due to ankle swelling.

citations.quote: Amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling;

claims.text: Amlodipine 5 mg daily was being taken as of 2026-07-28.
Blood pressure review was planned for two weeks after 2026-08-18.

citations.quote: review blood pressure in two weeks.

open_questions: When was amlodipine first started, and at what dose?
What was the blood pressure reading that led to stopping amlodipine?
Was the two-week blood pressure review completed, and what were the results?
Is there documentation of ankle swelling severity, onset timing, or assessment for alternative causes?
What antihypertensive, if any, replaced amlodipine after discontinuation?
Are there prior notes documenting tolerance or adverse effects of amlodipine before July 2026?
